environment.provider: existing configured DeepSeek provider, platform-funded support calls
environment.actorRole: platform administrator using both customer and staff interfaces

behavioralTesting: Built-in browser only; no automated test suite was run, as requested.

browserChecks.check: Embedded customer panel and persistent conversation history
browserChecks.observed: Conversations survived page refreshes and development reloads.
Created and published a factual Studio help article through Admin. The customer knowledge base displayed it and its article dialog opened.
A saved private draft appeared in Admin alongside the published article and was absent from the customer knowledge list.
DeepSeek answered the timeline question using the published article. The displayed source link opened that article.
A Korean product question produced a Korean answer grounded in the English Studio article, with the same article citation.
Before the platform-funded support credential accessor was installed, the existing sandbox guard prevented calls; a localized fallback was persisted and the chat entered the staff queue.
A staff member claimed the queued conversation and sent a reply. The customer saw it in the same transcript.
The Korean customer message appeared in English for staff; the English staff reply appeared in Korean for the customer. Original-text controls were present.
Private note markers appeared in Admin and were absent from the customer transcript. A second private note produced no customer unread badge and did not change the public subject.
Uploaded a generated PDF fixture through the customer panel, attached it to a message, and downloaded it through the staff inbox.
A generated plain-text fixture was rejected with the supported PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF error.
Created a linked support case; the existing case card displayed its conversation link. Concurrent message/case updates produced a safe revision conflict; retrying succeeded.
Staff resolved the conversation; the reply composer was removed and Reopen became available. Reopening restored the human queue.

Sent a new product question and immediately requested a human while Preparing an answer was visible. The chat entered the human queue. Several minutes later the customer still had only the two prior AI messages; no delayed AI reply appeared.
Checked English, French, Spanish, Korean, Japanese and Simplified Chinese in the Admin knowledge editor. Labels, navigation and statuses changed; unsaved title/category/body remained intact.

staticValidation.supportUiLint: no errors; two hook warnings (locale synchronization and explicit read-state dependencies)

coverageLimits: Browser checks used one existing staff account in separate customer/admin origins; a distinct-customer isolation and full staff-role matrix were not exercised.
Account erasure, storage holds, one-hour abandoned-upload cleanup and daily-limit exhaustion were reviewed in source but not triggered against live data.
No production deployment or staff-role changes were made.
Attachments are available to staff; AI image/PDF interpretation is not included.
Knowledge search and inbox filters operate on the displayed paginated page. AI retrieval searches the published chunk index.
The checked browser viewport was narrow; a separate wide-desktop layout session was not performed.
